_background_note: frontier-models-deepseek held in background deliberately despite a very loud day (V4-Flash-0731, two HN front-page threads, 30/6 source presence): the whole DeepSeek arc is already scored inside open-weight-cost-pressure, inference-cost-economics and frontier-models-llama-qwen-kimi, and carving it out would double-count one event. a2a-protocol got its first implementation-grounded paper today but scored 9.0, below the emerging floor.
_clustering_note: Cross-topic clusters are carried from the prior run under the §4.7(e) sticky-name rule (>=50% membership overlap). A literal shared-supporting_file co-mention graph is degenerate on this corpus — every topic cites the same eight daily collector files — so membership is maintained thematically and only edited when a topic's co-movement genuinely changes.

breadth_audit._purpose: Actor-attribution breadth. Publisher filter deterministic (breadth_config.publisher_slugs); contrast exclusion best-effort.
breadth_audit.contrast_comentions_excluded: agent estimate - dropped glm/zhipu and kimi/moonshot from frontier-models-openai where HN names them only as the competitive set explaining the price cut; dropped openai and anthropic from frontier-models-llama-qwen-kimi's benchmark contrast rows; dropped nvidia/qualcomm/amd from global-ai-governance-blocs (named as dependencies, not bloc actors); dropped simonwillison, latentspace, lawfare, t3n, heise, nzz, handelsblatt, techcrunch, arstechnica, marktechpost and cyberscoop as messengers throughout - datasette substituted on mcp-adoption/edge-inference because the shipped software, not the write-up, is the act
breadth_audit._threshold_note: median_breadth_30d is 20 against a high_breadth_7d floor of 8, so the flag fires on 37 of 39 topics and carries little information. Top-third of this distribution sits near 22 and the top quartile near 24 - a re-tune of breadth_config.thresholds is warranted but is a sources.json edit, not a radar-run action.

config_snapshot._purpose: exact tuning constants in effect this run, for reproducibility

thresholds._comment: Lowered 2026-06-03 from 15/20 alongside BREADTH_PLAN actor-attribution. Removing publishers + contrast co-mentions shrinks every topic's org set, so the old 15/20 floor (set against the inflated distribution) would almost never fire. After the first corrected radar run, read breadth_audit.median_breadth_30d and re-tune: high_breadth_7d ~= top-third of the NEW distribution, very_high ~= top-quartile.

stages._comment: Each topic falls into one stage based on score AND sustained signal. Tuning these thresholds shifts how aggressively the radar promotes/demotes themes.

emerging.description: Early signal. 1-2 weak sources or one strong novel source. Worth watching.

consolidating.description: Multiple independent sources are converging on the same take. Pattern is forming.

mainstream.description: Consensus. Most credible sources reference this; further coverage is incremental.

fading._trigger: score declined >25% over rolling window AND was previously >=50
fading.description: Was hot, now declining. Useful to know — don't bet here, expect coverage to dry up.
